nodes.name: Chunk Trigger
nodes.notes: The QuickEnrich chunk worker of Enrich Contacts (2026-09-09): one chunk of companies in (the lane contract plus companies), QuickEnrich asked at its documented pace, the people handed to Enrich Contacts Writer (awaited), counters out. Its own execution, so its payloads die with it.

nodes.name: QE Roster
nodes.notes: QuickEnrich: the free roster of a domain (no emails, has_email flags and LinkedIn URLs). 120 requests a minute documented; paced at 120.

nodes.name: QE Email
nodes.notes: QuickEnrich: the email search per person (LinkedIn URL first, then name + domain), one credit only on a hit. 1,000 requests a minute documented; paced at about 850.

nodes.name: Call Writer
nodes.notes: Awaited. The writer merges this chunk into People and answers counters; a crash comes back as an error item and is counted.
